vocab.definition: the upper chambers that receive blood into the heart.
the lower chambers that pump blood out of the heart.
carries blood away from the heart at high pressure.
carries blood back to the heart; has valves.

misconceptions.right: The pulmonary artery carries deoxygenated blood.

misconceptions.wrong: The heart is one single pump.
misconceptions.right: It is a double pump — right and left sides.

misconceptions.wrong: Blood flows in both directions in veins.
misconceptions.right: Valves keep blood flowing one way only.

infoPanels.title: STRUCTURE OF THE HEART
infoPanels.secondaryContent: The left ventricle has the thickest muscle to pump blood around the body.
